pages.scan: Read with the Read tool from works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-01.png. Three panels. (1) Full-width top panel: rectangular caption at top-left 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' A small Ananya face box sits centre-left. She has no balloon, so this is a silent establishing beat. (2) Bottom-left tall panel, Meera face box at centre-left. I read Meera's two balloons left then right: top-left 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' (tail down to the top of Meera's box), then right 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' (tail to the right edge of Meera's box). (3) Bottom-right tall panel, Ananya face box: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' (tail down to Ananya's box).
pages.observation: Reading order is clear. Meera's two balloons step left to right and down, both tails go to the one face box, and there is no rival balloon nearby. Ananya's reply in the next panel answers Meera's wish ('easier to manage' -> 'make the rest simpler'), so no answer is skipped. Ambiguities: (a) Meera is never introduced. The caption names only Dr. Ananya, so the reader cannot tell Meera's role (staff or receptionist?) or her relation to Ananya. Nothing shows whether they are in the same room or whether Meera is speaking to Ananya. (b) Ananya appears twice, small in panel 1 and in panel 3, with no visible action linking the establishing shot to the exchange. (c) The lower halves of both bottom panels and most of panel 1 are empty, so the art has to show the 'busy' workload, for example a desk, files or a queue. Otherwise the caption carries the claim alone. (d) Tails end at box edges, not at the mouth dots. This is acceptable in a storyboard, but check it once the art is placed. All text is readable.

pages.scan: Read with the Read tool from works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-04.png. Four panels. (1) Full-width top panel: Ananya box at centre-left, Ravi box at right. Ananya: 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.' (tail to Ananya). Ravi is silent. (2) Middle-left panel, Ravi box at left-centre: 'I've been feeling tired lately.' (3) Middle-right panel, Ananya box at right: rectangular narration caption 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' Ananya has no balloon here (silent reaction). (4) Full-width bottom panel: Ananya at centre-left, Ravi at right. Ananya: 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' (tail to Ananya). Ravi is silent.
pages.observation: The reading order is unambiguous: one text element per panel except panel 1, and the tails are short and point at the right face. Problems: (a) Ravi's symptom 'I've been feeling tired lately' gets a narration caption over a silent Ananya in panel 3 instead of a spoken reaction. The narrator's general message interrupts the consultation. Ananya's eventual reply in panel 4 is generic ('your concerns') and never acknowledges the tiredness or asks a follow-up, so the reply to the symptom feels skipped or delayed. The art must give Ananya a clear listening expression in panel 3, or the caption reads as a non-sequitur. (b) The left/right layout flips. In panels 1 and 4, Ananya is left and Ravi is right. In panels 2 and 3, Ravi's single shot is on the left and Ananya's is on the right. Unless the art handles the angle deliberately, this reads as the two characters swapping sides. (c) Ravi never reacts in panel 4 and the page ends on Ananya's line, so his response (relief or agreement) is not shown. (d) The setting is never stated on this page, though 'Hello, Ravi' implies a consultation. All text is readable.

pages.scan: Read with the Read tool from works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-05.png. Four panels. (1) Full-width top panel: Meera box at centre-left, Ravi box at right. Meera: 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' (tail to Meera). (2) Middle-left panel, Ravi box at right of the panel: 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' (long diagonal tail down-right to Ravi). Teal rounded label at bottom-left: 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients'. (3) Middle-right panel, Meera box: 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' (4) Full-width bottom panel: rectangular caption at top-left 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' A small, silent Ravi box is centre-right.
pages.observation: The order is clear, with no competing balloons in any panel. Ravi's question leads into Meera's 'That's the idea.' Problems: (a) The scene changes from the previous page with no transition. Page 4 ended with Ananya and Ravi, and here Meera is suddenly talking to Ravi. No caption or establishing cue says where they are or that time has passed (after the consultation? the front desk?). (b) Ravi's 'useful information in one place' does not follow from Meera's line, which only says 'stay connected with their care'. He seems to answer something not said aloud, unless the teal label or a screen or leaflet in the art shows that information. Also, the teal label is not tied to any visible object, so the reader cannot tell whether it is a sign, screen, phone or leaflet. (c) Meera promises 'Let's walk through what is available to you', but the next panel jumps straight to the closing caption. The walkthrough and Ravi's reaction to it are skipped, so the payoff is asserted, not shown. (d) Meera moves from the left in panel 1 to the right in panel 3, and Ravi is on the right in both panel 1 and panel 2, so the side placement is inconsistent. (e) Ravi in panel 4 is small, silent and alone, and his expression has to carry the 'smoother visit' feeling. All text is readable.
